title: Signature Study — Mach-Zehnder interferometer concept (1064 nm laser)
description: This is a Signature-authored optical design study for a Mach-Zehnder interferometer at 1064 nm laser. Design goals address the real aberration profile: Astigmatism: uneven curvature that splits the interference focus. Spherical aberration: wavefront error from imperfect optics under test. Corrected with a multi-element achromat. Intended application: optical surface testing.

aberration_notes: Astigmatism: uneven curvature that splits the interference focus.
Spherical aberration: wavefront error from imperfect optics under test.
